title: Gold Hits Record High on US Government Shutdown | The Pulse 10/1/2025
content:
Gold reached a new all-time high as the US began a government shutdown, threatening upheaval including delays to key economic data releases. Congress blew past a midnight funding deadline, triggering the US government’s first shutdown in nearly seven years — and the third under President Donald Trump.

Also on the show, live coverage from Bloomberg's Women, Money and Power event, featuring some of the most influential voices in global finance. 

Today's guests: Ursula Marchioni, BlackRock EMEA Investment and Portfolio Head as well as panel discussions from Bloomberg's Women, Money and Power event featuring Yie-Hsin Hung, State Street Investment Management CEO, Jenny Johnson, Franklin Templeton CEO, Anu Aiyengar, JPMorgan Global Head of Advisory & M&A,  Christina Minnis, Goldman Sachs Global Head of Credit & Asset Finance, May Nasrallah, PJT deNovo Executive Chair. (Source: Bloomberg)
